nodes.name: Generate Document Webhook
nodes.notes: POST { template_id, template_version?, document_type, recipient?, merge_data, idempotency_key }. Allocates a document number, renders, archives, emails and returns the result. Safe to retry with the same idempotency_key.

nodes.name: Preview Document Webhook
nodes.notes: Same body as /generate (idempotency_key not needed). Returns the rendered PDF. Allocates no number, archives nothing, sends nothing.

nodes.name: CONFIG
nodes.notes: THE ONLY NODE YOU NEED TO EDIT. Every URL, credential header, limit and formatting choice lives here. See the Read Me First note and the README.

nodes.name: Document Rules
nodes.notes: EDIT ME for what this business generates: extra document types, allowed templates, required fields, defaults, limits, recipient domains, per-template formatting. Data only; checked on every request. Number allocation, idempotency, the invoice maths, escaping and the PDF checks cannot be changed here.

nodes.name: Validate Request
nodes.notes: Auth token, CONFIG sanity and request-shape checks. Every failure here is a clean 401/400/500 with a reason, never a stack trace.

nodes.name: Respond JSON
nodes.notes: Every non-PDF answer in the workflow flows through this one node. The code node before it decides http_status and response_body.

nodes.name: Fetch Template
nodes.notes: GET {TEMPLATE_STORE}/templates/{id}?version=  -> 200 {active, required_fields, html} | 404. neverError is on so the code node can tell 404 from "store down".

nodes.name: Check Template
nodes.notes: Classifies the template-store answer: 404 not found / 409 inactive / 503 store down / 422 missing required fields.

nodes.name: Prepare Document
nodes.notes: Invoices: validates line items, recomputes subtotal/tax/total in integer cents, and rejects a caller-supplied total that disagrees. Runs BEFORE a document number is allocated, so a rejected request never burns a number.

nodes.name: Create Generation Record
nodes.notes: Atomic create-or-return-existing. 201 {document_number} = you own this key. 409 {existing:{document_number,status,archive_url}} = someone already does. The number is allocated here, by the store, never by the workflow.

nodes.name: Evaluate Record
nodes.notes: completed -> replay the cached answer (200). failed_needs_retry -> take the retry path with the SAME number. pending -> another request is working on it (409). Anything else is a clear 503.

nodes.name: Claim Retry
nodes.notes: Compare-and-set failed_needs_retry -> pending. Of two simultaneous retries exactly one wins (200); the loser gets 409.

nodes.name: Render Document
nodes.notes: A small, auditable template engine (no external library). Every substituted value is HTML-escaped, so merge data can never inject markup. Builds the index.html file Gotenberg expects.

nodes.name: Render PDF (Gotenberg)
nodes.notes: POST multipart/form-data, one file part named "files" called index.html (that is Gotenberg's contract). NOT neverError: a 5xx must throw so retryOnFail actually retries (3 tries). A final failure continues to the failure path.

nodes.name: Check PDF
nodes.notes: Does not trust a 200: the bytes must actually start with %PDF before anything is archived or returned.

nodes.name: Respond PDF (Preview)
nodes.notes: Preview returns the PDF itself. Template warnings (unresolved fields etc.) ride along in X-Warnings (URL-encoded JSON).

nodes.name: Archive PDF
nodes.notes: Uploads the actual PDF (multipart: a "pdf" file part plus the fields). Must be idempotent per document_number, because it can be retried. Not neverError, so 5xx retries.

nodes.name: Mark Completed
nodes.notes: Flips the record to completed (idempotent). If even this fails after retries the document is still delivered; the response carries a warning and ops are alerted.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { to: $json.recipient.email, recipient_name: $json.recipient.name || null, document_number: $json.document_number, document_type: $json.document_type, template_id: $json.template_id, archive_url: $json.archive_url } }}

nodes.name: Send Email
nodes.notes: Delivery is best-effort and isolated: if this fails the document is safe and the caller still gets 201 (with a warning).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { text: ':warning: Document ' + $('Check Delivery').first().json.document_number + ' was generated and archived, but the email to ' + $('Check Delivery').first().json.recipient.email + ' failed. The document is safe; it needs a manual resend.' } }}

nodes.name: Alert Ops (Delivery Failed)
nodes.notes: Blank SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL = no alerts (this node is skipped).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { event: 'document_generated', document_number: $('Prepare Delivery').first().json.document_number, document_type: $('Prepare Delivery').first().json.document_type, idempotency_key: $('Prepare Delivery').first().json.idempotency_key, template_id: $('Prepare Delivery').first().json.template_id, archive_url: $('Prepare Delivery').first().json.archive_url, warnings: $('Prepare Delivery').first().json.warnings } }}

nodes.name: Failure Context
nodes.notes: All three failure stages (render, pdf, archive) land here and become one consistent 5xx.

nodes.name: Mark Failed (Needs Retry)
nodes.notes: Releases the idempotency key for a retry. If this call itself fails the caller still gets the 5xx; the record stays pending until the store expires it (see README, service contract).

parameters.content:
## Template-Driven Document Generator
**Setup (about 5 minutes)**
1. Run the reference services: `node 11-template-document-generator-mock-server.js` (port 4100). In production, point CONFIG at your own services instead.
2. Open **CONFIG**. Defaults already target the mock on localhost:4100. If n8n runs in Docker, use `host.docker.internal`.
3. Activate and POST to `/webhook/documents/generate` or `/webhook/documents/preview`.

**Everything configurable lives in CONFIG.** No node has a hardcoded URL, vendor or credential.

**Flow:** validate -> fetch template -> check fields and invoice totals -> allocate number (generate only) -> render -> PDF -> archive -> mark completed -> email + audit -> 201.
Anything that fails after a number exists marks the record `failed_needs_retry`, so the same idempotency_key can safely retry.

## Services this workflow calls (HTTP contract in the README)
- Template store: `GET /templates/{id}?version=`
- Document store: `POST /generations` (atomic), `POST /generations/{key}`, `POST /archive`
- Renderer: Gotenberg `POST /forms/chromium/convert/html`
- Notify: `POST /send-document-email`
- Audit: `POST /log`
- Alerts (optional): a Slack-compatible incoming webhook
